title: Windows Graphics Capture Evidence Pilot
scope: Introduce an evidence-only capture boundary behind the UiSmoke recorder.
Probe Windows.Graphics.Capture against the actual Command Center HWND without changing product motion.
Preserve exact-head, 1440x900, 30 FPS target, raw-frame hashing, semantic event timeline, Full/Reduced separation and current timing tolerance.

candidate_dependency.source_audit_note: The public CaptureWindow API creates a new D3D/WGC session per screenshot, skips the first frame, then waits 50ms before the accepted frame; therefore direct per-frame use must not be assumed capable of sustained 30 FPS.

evidence_required: actual capture duration within existing tolerance
